Links Between Elements in a JointJS Diagram

jointjs_link.Rd

Create a link between a source and target element or location in a JointJS diagram.

Super class

jointjs_cell -> jointjs_link

Methods

Public methods

  • jointjs_link$new()

  • jointjs_link$clone()

Inherited methods
  • jointjs_cell$get_list()
  • jointjs_cell$set_attrs()

jointjs_link$new()

The link initialiser.

Usage

jointjs_link$new(source, target, vertices, ...)

Arguments

source, target

source and target indicate the route the link should take. It can be a point (a list with an x and y coordinate), or a list containing an id of the element that should be linked. You can also provide a port value to that list if you wish to connect to a specific port on the element.

vertices

A list of coordinates where the link should pass through. The list is unnamed and each element should be a list of and x and y value.

...

Arguments passed to parent class initialiser.

Examples

jointjs_link$new(vertices = list(
    list(x = 50, y = 50),
    list(x = 40, y = 60)
  ))

jointjs_link$clone()

Usage

jointjs_link$clone(deep = FALSE)

deep
